subject: Kickoff - Project Quillon (GFSA graph-structure layer)
body:
Hi Jelena,

Kickoff for the GFSA workstream. Internally we are calling this effort Project Quillon - please use that name in decks and OKR entries so the portfolio roll-up stays consistent.

The pitch: our open-source GFSA layer learns new edge types for a graph by training a finite-state automaton policy over the base graph, end to end. The demo notebook already learns a simple static analysis of Python code, and the new-task guide shows how to attach the layer to other graphs and graph-based MDPs. For graphs-retrieval, that becomes a differentiable edge-inference module customers can drop into their own graph stacks.

Milestones inside our window: static-analysis repro by 4/24, one new retrieval-flavored task by 5/22, LRB pre-read targeting 6/11.

Fumiko leads research, Hyun on modeling, Bilal on infra, Halima part-time on evals. Jelena - staffing confirmation and a compute sketch by Thursday?

Anders
